text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Crown Prince Hassan says in Washington that politics of despair helps extremism. Deputy Prime Minister Jawad al-Anani says Crown Prince's visit to Washington a complete success; says President Clinton appreciates Jordan's active role in peace process.
- Iraqi Deputy Prime Minister Tareq Aziz says after talks with Prime Minister Abdul-Salam al-Majali that relations with Jordan are firm and will not be affected by any changes.

- Central Bank governor Ziad Fariz says foreign reserves reach $950 million. Interest rates on certificates of deposits fall. Remittances up 16 percent, exports up 8.2 percent in first five months of 1997.
- Majali says return of land is the basis of the Middle East peace process. Says Jordan working for Arab unity.
- Crown Prince calls for investment in Jordan at a meeting of leading economists and businessmen in Colorado.
